title: SUEDE
headline: Reviews that actually fit
category: Fashion review platform · UX audit and redesign
summary: Redesigning a fashion review platform that matches real body measurements to real reviews, so shoppers can buy with confidence.
cover_alt: Black-and-white fashion photograph used as the SUEDE case study cover, titled UI/UX Audit & Product Redesign.
decision: I put fit first: real reviews, matched to real body measurements.

story.heading: Overview
story.body: We're redesigning SUEDE, a fashion review platform that matches real body measurements to real reviews so shoppers can buy with confidence. The focus is on trust, fit accuracy, and a consistent, photo-first experience. We're currently finishing the before/after comparison and polishing the final case study.
